name: Somalia
famous_for: Longest coastline in mainland Africa, historic Mogadishu stone architecture, frankincense production, and 'Nation of Poets' heritage.
tourists: Approx. 50,000 visitors (mostly diaspora and business); famous for Mogadishu Lido beach and Puntland frankincense groves.
must_know: Somalia is celebrated throughout the Arab and African worlds as the 'Nation of Poets' because oral poetry holds immense social power.
fun_fact: Somalia possesses over 3,330 kilometers of unbroken Indian Ocean and Gulf of Aden coastline, the longest on mainland Africa.
